item.title: [HAIR FOR HOPE] Sign up for Hair for Hope 2026!
item.description: Hey Hwa Chong! In collaboration with the Children’s Cancer Foundation, the ProEd Council is proud to present HAIR FOR HOPE 2026. Join us for this meaningful and inspiring event! What is Hair for Hope ? It is a charity event where participants shave their heads to raise awareness of childhood cancer, as well as raise funds for impacted children and families. It’s more than just a shave—it’s a bold statement of solidarity with children battling cancer. By shaving your head, you raise awareness, show support, and help provide essential funds for children and families impacted by childhood cancer. Why Join? ✔ Stand in solidarity with young warriors fighting cancer ✔ Raise awareness and inspire change ✔ Shave for FREE and be part of something bigger than yourself Details for Hair For Hope: Date: Thursday, 14th May (T2W8) Time: 2:00–5:00 PM Venue: HCI OTH (high school section) Do note that the online registration will close on 7 May 2026, 5pm. This is your chance to make a difference. Be brave. Be bold. Be a cut above the rest. ✂💙 Sign up at the link below and be part of the cause! See you there! 💙 Sign up and make a donation here! Satellite Code: 808452 Link to Event: https://hairforhope.org.sg/fundraising/satellite/hwa-chong-institution

item.title: [ECG] REMINDER: Join Our UK & US Essay Writing Workshops
item.description: Dear Students, **This is a friendly about our UK Personal Statement & US Essay Writing workshops. If you have already signed up for the session(s), please kindly disregard this message.** Are you planning to apply to universities in the UK or the US? Your personal statement or college essay is a crucial part of your application. Knowing how to craft it effectively can make all the difference. We are excited to invite you to two exclusive essay writing workshops led by admissions experts. These sessions will provide valuable insights into what universities are looking for and how you can present your story in a compelling and authentic way. By attending, you will: Gain insider perspectives from admissions professionals Learn practical strategies to strengthen your essays Understand common pitfalls and how to avoid them Develop confidence in presenting your experiences and achievements Whether you're targeting the UK or US, these workshops will equip you with the tools to stand out in a competitive applicant pool. UK Personal Statement Writing Workshop Conducted by King’s College London 📅 Date: Friday, 8 May 2026 ⏰ Time: 3:30 – 5:00 PM 📍 Venue: D401, Block D Level 4 🔗 Registration: https://forms.gle/6uvy8P8n3XVyBuji9 US College Essay Writing Workshop Conducted by University of San Francisco 📅 Date: Friday, 15 May 2026 ⏰ Time: 3:00 – 4:30 PM 📍 Venue: ECG LT, Block D Level 3 🔗 Registration: https://forms.gle/Ch38F9rgQMW6WGqh8 --- Seats are limited! We encourage all prospective applicants to sign up early to secure your place. We look forward to seeing you there. Best regards, ECG Department

item.title: First Aid Club × Singapore Red Cross Blood Donation Drive 2026 — Sign Up Now 🩸
item.description: Hey Hwa Chong! First Aid Club is proud to host our annual Blood Donation Drive in partnership with Singapore Red Cross! Every day, donated blood is needed for patients undergoing surgery, recovering from accidents, or battling serious illnesses. In Singapore, 328 units of blood are required daily to meet national demand—making every donor a vital part of sustaining the blood supply. 📍 Event Details 📆 Date: 26 May 2026 ⏰ Time: 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM 📌 Venue: Common Room Donating blood takes only a small fraction of your time, but its impact is profound. What may feel like a simple act can mean hope, recovery, and a second chance at life for someone in need. We strongly encourage all students, teachers, and staff to step forward and make a difference. 🧑‍⚕️ All donations will be conducted by trained healthcare professionals from the Singapore Red Cross, ensuring a safe and comfortable experience for every donor. Sign-up form: https://forms.gle/KJ9sCY7XxUgbnhxv5 Walk-ins are welcome, but donors with allocated timeslots will be prioritised. For students under 18, parental consent is required (accessible via the sign-up form). Every donation counts. Join us in making a real impact—your small act of kindness could save a life. Follow us on Instagram @hcfirstaid for updates 💗 For more information about blood donation, visit the Singapore Red Cross website: https://redcross.sg/ or speak to them at the roadshow. 📢 Blood Donation Drive Roadshow Want to learn more before donating? Visit our roadshow! 📆 Date: 19 May 2026 ⏰ Time: 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM 📌 Venue: Staircase linking Left Wing and Canteen If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact the Organising Chairperson, Talia (212212b@student.hci.edu.sg), or the Vice-Chairperson, Jayden (212187j@student.hci.edu.sg) via GChat.

item.title: [Library] Exciting News : Free access to The New York Times
item.description: Dear Student, As a student at Hwa Chong Institution you are entitled to FREE , unlimited access to everything The New York Times offers, including News, Games, Cooking, Audio, Wirecutter and The Athletic. Get started by going to this link and following the Sign-up instructions. Or you may like to view the Activation video to find activation instructions. And be sure to check out The Learning Network — an invaluable resource to help you learn with The Times — and the New York Times inEducation home page , where you’ll find journalism organized by 12 key areas of study. Access is available via NYTimes.com and all New York Times apps, available for download for iOS and Android devices. And, please help spread the word to other students. Should you require any assistance, please feel free to approach library staff at the counter or email: library@hci.edu.sg Have a great learning experience! Best regards, HCI Libraries
